newsitem.title: UK: UK's CRT Group buys software design firm.
newsitem.headline: UK's CRT Group buys software design firm.

text.p: British consultancy and training services firm CRT Group Plc said on Thursday it had acquired another British software firm Software Design Associates for 17 million stg.
The consideration will comprise 15 million stg in cash and bank guaranteed loan notes and 2.0 million in ordinary shares in the CRT Group, the company said.
SDA provides information technology systems support aimed at retail, finance, telecommunications and utilities sector.
The company employs 231 people in three locations, one in London and two in Birmingham.
SDA had sales of nine million stg and pre-tax profits of 1.2 million stg in the year to December 31, 1996.
